questions.topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
questions.stemEn: A 3-year-old child has received no vaccines since age 2 months. Which vaccines should be given at this visit?

options.text: HBV, HAV, DTaP, IPV, PCV13, MCV4, MMR
HBV, HAV, DTaP, IPV, PCV13, MCV4, MMR, Varicella

questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار B ويذكر أن rotavirus وBCG لن يعطيا في هذا العمر. لكن catch-up schedules وتراكيب pneumococcal vaccines والجدول السعودي تتغير مع الزمن؛ لذلك هذا السؤال يُحفظ كـhistorical exam recall ولا يُنشر كإرشاد حالي قبل التحقق من Saudi MOH schedule.
questions.reasoningEn: The source’s 2024/2021 catch-up key excludes BCG and rotavirus at age three, but the exact current catch-up products and schedule are time-sensitive.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: الاختلاف بين الخيارات يعتمد على age limits والجدول الوطني؛ لا نعتمد المقارنة الحالية قبل تحديث المرجع.
questions.clinicalPearl: Never restart a vaccine series solely because of delay; catch-up schedules use prior valid doses and minimum intervals.

tts.text: A three-year-old child has received no vaccines since age two months. Which vaccines should be given at this visit? A. HBV, HAV, DTaP, IPV, PCV13, MCV4, MMR. B. The same plus varicella. C. Option B plus BCG. D. Option B plus rotavirus.

sourceRefs.notes: Also 2021; source cites Saudi MOH catch-up schedule.

verification.referenceNotes: Must verify against current Saudi MOH national immunization schedule before publication.

questions.topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
questions.stemEn: What were the recent changes to the Saudi vaccination schedule in the recalled exam?

options.text: IPV, OPV, DTaP, hepatitis B, Hib, PCV and BCG at age 6 months
Tdap and HPV at age 11 years

questions.explanationAr: المصدر نفسه يقول إن الإجابة تعتمد على الخيارات ويطلب مراجعة الجدول القديم والجديد. لذلك هذا ليس سؤالًا صالحًا للنشر بإجابة واحدة دون تحديد سنة الجدول المقصود.
questions.reasoningEn: The source explicitly states that the correct answer depends on the provided options and schedule version.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: لا يمكن وصف أحد الخيارين بأنه خطأ بشكل آمن دون تثبيت نسخة الجدول والسنة.
questions.clinicalPearl: National vaccine schedules are versioned, time-sensitive references.

tts.text: What were the recent changes to the Saudi vaccination schedule in the recalled exam? A. IPV, OPV, DTaP, hepatitis B, Hib, PCV and BCG at age six months. B. Tdap and HPV at age eleven years.

questions.topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
questions.stemEn: A mother of a 7-month-old infant born at 30 weeks' gestation asks about influenza vaccination. What should you advise?

options.text: Give two intramuscular doses four weeks apart

questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار جرعتين IM بفاصل 4 أسابيع إذا كان الطفل في موسم اللقاح ويأخذه لأول مرة؛ prematurity بحد ذاتها لا تؤخر التطعيم بعد بلوغ العمر الزمني المناسب. لكن يجب ربط السؤال بالتاريخ السابق للتطعيم والجدول السعودي الحالي.
questions.reasoningEn: The source applies the first-season two-dose influenza schedule for children aged six months through eight years who are not previously vaccinated.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: LAIV غير مناسب لهذا العمر، والقول بعدم التوصية غير متوافق مع المصدر. جرعة واحدة تعتمد على وجود تطعيم سابق كافٍ.
questions.clinicalPearl: Vaccinate preterm infants by chronological age for routine vaccines unless a specific product rule says otherwise.

tts.text: A mother of a seven-month-old infant born at thirty weeks' gestation asks about influenza vaccination. What should you advise? A. Give one intramuscular dose. B. Give two intramuscular doses four weeks apart. C. Give intranasal vaccine. D. Influenza vaccine is not recommended.

sourceRefs.sourceName: Pediatric Saudi Board Exams Question Collection 4th Ed 2026
sourceRefs.notes: Source cites Saudi influenza vaccination guidance.

verification.referenceNotes: Verify current Saudi influenza schedule and prior-dose criteria before publication.

questions.topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
questions.subtopic: Live vaccines in household contact of pregnancy
questions.stemEn: A pregnant mother at 17 weeks asks whether her infant can receive the scheduled 12-month live attenuated vaccines. What should you tell her?

options.text: Do not give varicella and MMR vaccines

questions.explanationAr: كون الطفل household contact لامرأة حامل ليس بحد ذاته contraindication لـMMR أوvaricella. المصدر يؤكد أن تطعيم المخالطين الأصحاء يقلل خطر نقل wild-type infection للحوامل.
questions.reasoningEn: Healthy household contacts of pregnant people generally receive routine vaccines, including indicated live vaccines.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: منع MMR وvaricella فقط لأن الأم حامل غير مدعوم في المصدر.
questions.clinicalPearl: Pregnancy is a contraindication for certain live vaccines in the pregnant person, not automatically for healthy household contacts.

tts.text: A pregnant mother at seventeen weeks asks whether her infant can receive the scheduled twelve-month live attenuated vaccines. What should you tell her? A. Give all vaccines as scheduled. B. Do not give varicella and MMR vaccines.

sourceRefs.sourceName: Pediatric Saudi Board Exams Question Collection 4th Ed 2026

questions.topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
questions.stemEn: PPSV23 is indicated for which of the following?

options.text: 12-year-old patient with previous severe pneumococcal disease

questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار HIV، لكن pneumococcal recommendations تغيرت مع PCV15/PCV20 والعمر وحالات high-risk، كما أن sickle cell disease نفسها risk condition. لذلك لا نثبت C كإجابة حديثة دون مراجعة current schedule.
questions.reasoningEn: The historical source key is C, but pneumococcal risk-based vaccination recommendations have changed substantially.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: لا يمكن رفض SCA أوباقي الخيارات اعتمادًا على معلومات حديثة دون مراجعة العمر والسلسلة السابقة ونوع PCV المستخدم.
questions.clinicalPearl: Pneumococcal vaccine questions are product- and age-specific and should always be tied to a current schedule.

tts.text: PPSV23 is indicated for which of the following? A. An eighteen-month-old patient with sickle cell anemia. B. A twelve-year-old with previous severe pneumococcal disease. C. A thirteen-year-old patient with HIV.

questions.topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
questions.stemEn: A child returns from Pakistan without receiving recommended travel vaccines and now has bloody diarrhea. What is the most likely cause?
questions.explanationAr: الـtravel clue إلى Pakistan مع عدم أخذ typhoid vaccine يقود المصدر إلى Salmonella typhi. المصدر يذكر أن typhoid endemic في Indian subcontinent وأن salmonellosis قد تسبب diarrhea وقد تحتوي دمًا ومخاطًا.
questions.reasoningEn: Travel to the Indian subcontinent without typhoid vaccination is the key source clue favoring Salmonella Typhi among the listed options.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Malaria لا تُفسر bloody diarrhea بهذا النمط، TB وHepatitis A لا يطابقان presentation الحاد.
questions.clinicalPearl: In returned travelers, exposure history, fever pattern and stool/blood cultures matter; travel-vaccine omission is a clue, not a definitive test.

tts.text: A child returns from Pakistan without receiving recommended travel vaccines and now has bloody diarrhea. What is the most likely cause? A. Salmonella typhi. B. Falciparum vivax. C. Tuberculosis. D. Hepatitis A.

questions.topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
questions.stemEn: A 6-year-old has a puncture wound from a rusty nail with laceration. Vaccination status is unknown. What should be given now?

options.text: Tetanus toxoid-containing vaccine and tetanus immune globulin

questions.explanationAr: Puncture wound يُعد tetanus-prone/dirty wound، ومع unknown vaccination status يختار المصدر tetanus-containing vaccine مع TIG.
questions.reasoningEn: A dirty puncture wound plus unknown primary tetanus immunization status warrants both active and passive prophylaxis in the source.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Td وحده لا يوفر passive protection عند unknown/incomplete series، وNothing غير مناسب.
questions.clinicalPearl: For tetanus wound management, classify both the wound and the prior primary-series status.

tts.text: A six-year-old has a puncture wound from a rusty nail with laceration. Vaccination status is unknown. What should be given now? A. Tetanus toxoid-containing vaccine and tetanus immune globulin. B. Td. C. Nothing.

sourceRefs.sourceName: Pediatric Saudi Board Exams Question Collection 4th Ed 2026

verification.referenceNotes: Verify age-appropriate vaccine product in current guidance.

questions.topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
questions.stemEn: A 6-year-old has a rusty-nail puncture wound with a 3 cm laceration and tenderness. The last tetanus-containing vaccine was at age 18 months. What should be given now?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار Nothing، ويبدو أن منطقه أن آخر جرعة كانت قبل أقل من 5 سنوات تقريبًا. لكن اكتمال primary series غير موضح، وعمر الطفل يجعل اختيار المنتج نفسه مهمًا؛ لذلك السؤال incomplete ويحتاج مراجعة.
questions.reasoningEn: The recalled key assumes adequate prior immunization and a last tetanus dose within the five-year threshold for a dirty wound.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: لا يمكن تثبيت الحاجة إلى DTaP/Tdap/TIG دون معرفة اكتمال السلسلة السابقة بدقة.
questions.clinicalPearl: A precise tetanus question needs both time since last dose and number of valid prior doses.

tts.text: A six-year-old has a rusty-nail puncture wound with a three-centimeter laceration and tenderness. The last tetanus-containing vaccine was at age eighteen months. What should be given now? A. Tetanus toxoid-containing vaccine and immunoglobulin. B. Tdap. C. DTaP. D. Nothing.

sourceRefs.sourceName: Pediatric Saudi Board Exams Question Collection 4th Ed 2026

verification.referenceNotes: Incomplete immunization history; current wound-management table required.

questions.topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
questions.stemEn: An 11-year-old presents with a small puncture wound from a rusty nail. His last tetanus-containing vaccine was at age 4 years. What should be given now?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار Td لأن آخر tetanus-containing dose كانت قبل أكثر من 5 سنوات مع puncture wound. لكن في عمر 11 سنة، current schedules قد تفضل Tdap بحسب تاريخ الجرعات؛ لذلك مفتاح Td تاريخي ويحتاج تحديثًا.
questions.reasoningEn: The historical key gives a tetanus booster because more than five years have passed since the last dose in a tetanus-prone wound.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: عدم إعطاء vaccine لا يطابق threshold المستخدم في المصدر، وDT ليس المنتج المعتاد لهذه الفئة العمرية في كثير من الجداول الحديثة.
questions.clinicalPearl: The need for a booster may be stable, but the age-appropriate tetanus product can change with schedule updates.

tts.text: An eleven-year-old presents with a small puncture wound from a rusty nail. His last tetanus-containing vaccine was at age four years. What should be given now? A. DT. B. Td. C. Vaccine is not indicated.

questions.topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
questions.stemEn: A fully vaccinated 6-year-old is bitten by a dog that is immunized against rabies. The wound is a superficial abrasion on the forearm. What is the next step?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار wound debridement/irrigation كالإجراء الفوري الأساسي. Rabies PEP يعتمد على epidemiology وقدرة observation للحيوان، وtetanus يعتمد على آخر جرعة، وantibiotic prophylaxis لا يلزم كل superficial bite.
questions.reasoningEn: Immediate wound cleansing and irrigation are fundamental after animal bites; other prophylaxis depends on exposure and host factors.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Rabies immunoglobulin ليس تلقائيًا لمجرد العضة إذا كان الحيوان متاحًا للتقييم حسب النظام المحلي. Tetanus وantibiotics يعتمدان على history ونوع الجرح.
questions.clinicalPearl: Thorough irrigation is one of the most important immediate interventions after an animal bite.

tts.text: A fully vaccinated six-year-old is bitten by a dog that is immunized against rabies. The wound is a superficial abrasion on the forearm. What is the next step? A. Give prophylactic antibiotics. B. Give tetanus prophylaxis. C. Give rabies immunoglobulin. D. Debridement and irrigation.

sourceRefs.sourceName: Pediatric Saudi Board Exams Question Collection 4th Ed 2026
sourceRefs.notes: Also 2023; source cites UpToDate and AAP bite guidance.

verification.referenceNotes: Rabies management is location-sensitive; verify Saudi public-health guidance before publication.

questions.topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
questions.stemEn: What prophylactic antibiotic should be used for a fully vaccinated child who was bitten by a cat?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار amoxicillin-clavulanate، ويشير إلى أن PREP questions المشابهة اختارت بدائل مثل clindamycin + TMP-SMX فقط عندما وُجد penicillin allergy. ومع ذلك، الحاجة أصلًا إلى prophylaxis تعتمد على نوع ومكان وعمق العضة.
questions.reasoningEn: When antibiotic prophylaxis is indicated for a cat bite, amoxicillin-clavulanate provides broad coverage including Pasteurella and oral anaerobes.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Erythromycin وceftriaxone ليسا الخيار القياسي الأحادي المعتاد في source scenario.
questions.clinicalPearl: Cat bites are puncture-prone; assess hand involvement, depth, immunocompromise and signs of infection when deciding prophylaxis.

tts.text: What prophylactic antibiotic should be used for a fully vaccinated child who was bitten by a cat? A. Amoxicillin-clavulanate. B. Erythromycin. C. Ceftriaxone.
